run_check_self_overlaps: run the script to check for overlapping data between test and training splits in multilingual NMT data
run_check_diff: run check_diff to find common sentence pairs between source and target parallel corpus files
run_get_directions: run get_directions to discover all language pair directions from training files in a data folder
run_diff_list: run diff_list to compute the set difference between two lists of items
run_main: run main to check where test or valid split data appears in training data across language directions
